cols.t: Stat+ = 100 + 25 z; z = BPM against his position's (G, F, C) minutes-weighted mean and sd that season (2025-26 until this season has 40 a position), players with 10%+ of team minutes
Barttorvik box plus-minus: points a 100 possessions over an average D-I player
offensive rating: points produced a 100 possessions used
share of team possessions used on the floor
assist rate: share of teammates' field goals he assisted on the floor
steal rate: share of opponent possessions
block rate: share of opponent two-point attempts
free throw rate: FTA a 100 FGA
